column_description: TEXT. Unique identifier for each risk assessment. PK.
TEXT. Reference to the artifact being assessed for risk. FK to ArtifactsCore.ARTregID.
TEXT. Reference to the exhibition hall being assessed for risk. FK to ExhibitionHalls.Hall_ID.
TEXT. Level of risk associated with the artifact or hall. Possible values: High, Low, Medium.
TEXT. Emergency plan related to the risk. Possible values: Review Required, Under Revision, Updated.
TEXT. Evacuation priority level for the artifact or hall. Possible values: Priority 1, Priority 2, Priority 3.
TEXT. Handling rules for the artifact or hall. Possible values: Minimal, Strict.
BIGINT. Conservation score for the artifact or hall. Example: 85.0.
